## Problem / Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? What is the research use case?

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like. Be specific about:
- Which layer it touches (Domain / Application / Infrastructure / Interface)
- Whether it involves AI-generated output (and how it's gated)
- Whether it adds new data sources

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you considered.

## Additional Context

Links, references, or examples that might help.

## Hard Constraints (confirm before submitting)

- [ ] This feature does NOT automatically import Evidence without human review
- [ ] This feature does NOT produce trading advice or buy/sell signals
- [ ] This feature does NOT bypass Stage Gate rules
